item.ptxt: Before working, clean off any mud or other foreign matter on the clip.
Because the quick connector uses an O-ring to seal the pipe and connector, take sufficient care not to scratch the connecting parts or allow foreign matter to adhere to them.
Always perform removal and installation by hand without using tools.
Do not forcibly bend, kink or rotate the nylon tube.
After disconnecting, protect the connecting parts with a plastic bag.
If the connector and pipe are stuck, release them by rotating the nylon tube by hand, etc., then pull out the nylon tube to disconnect it.
